name: Horse
visual_note: Observed the installed four-direction montage and runtime strip. Left/Right retain the original compact golden spotted horse, cream swept forelock, pale noseband, ivory-gray saddle-pad border and long ochre tail; none of the four views shows a ground shadow. Up shows outer ears and an eyeless rear head, saddle on the back, rounded rump and a tail hanging from the rump; Down has a centered muzzle, two ears and a diagonal forelock obscuring one eye, with limb roots covered by the torso and no visibly detached appendages. Sampled Up/Down walk frames show alternating hoof positions and changing tail angles while the saddle stays attached; attack samples retain the front/rear structure. Up death samples show a full-body white flash, then a sideways fall and progressive transparency until almost invisible. Same-instance pool reuse and restored expression/alpha are confirmed separately by the two runtime assertion reports, not claimed as direct visual observation.
